title: Release: the macOS build fails on Rust 1.100 — pin the Rust version to 1.99.1 in the workflows
summary: The macOS release build broke when Rust 1.100 changed Cargo's build-folder layout, which tauri-build 2.5.6 cannot handle. The Release and PR Checks workflows now pin Rust 1.99.1 until tauri-build supports the new layout.
friction: GitHub silently disables Actions on forks it judges heavy ('Workflows on this fork have been disabled'); the API reports Actions enabled while dispatch returns 422 'Actions has been disabled', and nothing ran from 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-15. Re-enabling is a button on the repository's Actions page.
lessons_learned: The Rust pin in .github/workflows must be lifted once tauri-build copes with Cargo 1.100's build-dir layout; dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable will otherwise break the macOS release again.
